title: Mediterranean Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty, flavorful tagine originating from North Africa, featuring tender lamb and aromatic spices.
instructions: 2. Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, cumin, cinnamon, and ginger.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
4. Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
6. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
7. Add the lamb shoulder back to the pot, along with 1 cup of water.
8. Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
9. Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
